title: Northbeam TechWorks Credit Control: The Labour a Member Is Actually Charged For
content:
The labour that share is worked out on is the labour the customer is actually charged for. On a Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair job the write-offs already standing on the job decide, ground by ground, how much of the labour that is.

## The reading

**Where a write-off granted on a plan's cover stands on the job**, no part of that labour is taken into the share at all, since labour a plan has covered is already free and a discount on it would mean nothing.

**Where write-offs on another ground stand on the job and none granted on a plan's cover does**, the share is worked out on that labour less what those write-offs have already taken off it, since the discount is given on the labour the customer is charged for.

**Where neither of those situations holds**, that labour is taken into the share as it stands.

## The same reading as a table

| Write-offs standing on the job | The labour the share is worked out on |
| --- | --- |
| at least one granted on a plan's cover | no part of that labour at all |
| some on another ground, none on a plan's cover | that labour less what those write-offs have already taken off it |
| none at all | that labour as it stands |

The first line governs whenever a write-off on a plan's cover stands on the job, whatever other write-offs stand beside it. The second is reached only where no write-off on a plan's cover stands.

## Illustrations on hypothetical jobs

*The amounts below are chosen for the illustration and are not figures of any job on file.*

**No write-off at all.** A hypothetical job carries a labour figure of 214.60 USD and nothing written off. That labour is taken into the share as it stands, and the share is worked out on 214.60 USD.

**A plan write-off standing.** The same job carries a write-off of 145.80 USD granted on the plan's cover. That labour is already free to the customer, so no part of it is taken into the share and the share is worked out on nothing.

**A goodwill write-off standing, and no plan write-off.** The same job instead carries a write-off of 28.00 USD granted as a goodwill gesture. The labour the customer is actually charged for is 214.60 less 28.00, so the share is worked out on 186.60 USD.
